fact.text: He joined his hometown club Newcastle United in 1996 for a then world record £15 million.
In 2023 he became the most expensive signing in Bundesliga history, joining Bayern Munich for €110 million.
He debuted for England aged 17 and is still the country's youngest-ever goalscorer.
In his first Liverpool season he scored 32 league goals, a record for a 38-game Premier League season.
He was the first player to top both the Premier League's scoring and assist charts in the same season.
Debuting at 15 years and 35 days, he broke the Argentine league age record of his future father-in-law, Maradona.
He is one of the few footballers to have made over 1,000 competitive appearances.
At Arsenal he won the Premier League Golden Boot a record four times.
The Kop at Anfield nicknamed him "God", though he grew up an Everton fan.
He holds the Premier League record for most goals scored as a substitute, with 24.
